ammo.desc: Part of your inventory - ammo for active weapon.

ammo1.desc: Part of your inventory - ammo - shells.

ammo2.desc: Part of your inventory - ammo - nails.

ammo3.desc: Part of your inventory - ammo - rockets.

ammo4.desc: Part of your inventory - ammo - cells.

armor.desc: Part of your inventory - armor level.

armordamage.desc: Shows amount of damage done to your armour.

centerprint.desc: Shows alerts from server, countdowns etc.

fps.desc: Shows your current framerate in frames per second (fps).This can also show the minimum framerate that occured in the last measured period.

frags.desc: Show list of player frags in short form.

framestats.desc: Shows information about the renderer's status & workload.

frametime.desc: Shows your current frametime in ms.This can also show the maximum frametime that occured in the last measured period.

gun.desc: Part of your inventory - current weapon.

gun3.desc: Part of your inventory - super shotgun.

gun5.desc: Part of your inventory - super nailgun.

gun6.desc: Part of your inventory - grenade launcher.

gun7.desc: Part of your inventory - rocket launcher.

health.desc: Part of your status - health level.

healthdamage.desc: Shows amount of damage done to your health.

iammo.desc: Part of your inventory - ammo icon.

iammo1.desc: Part of your inventory - ammo icon.

iammo2.desc: Part of your inventory - ammo icon.

iammo3.desc: Part of your inventory - ammo icon.

iammo4.desc: Part of your inventory - ammo icon.

iarmor.desc: Part of your inventory - armor icon.

key1.desc: Part of your inventory - silver key.

key2.desc: Part of your inventory - gold key.

keys.desc: Shows which keys user does press at the moment

net.desc: Shows network statistics, like latency, packet loss, average packet sizes and bandwidth. Shown only when you are connected to a server.

netgraph.desc: Shows your network conditions in graph-form. With netgraph you can monitor your latency (ping), packet loss and network errors.

netproblem.desc: Shows an icon if you are experiencing network problems

ping.desc: Shows most important net conditions, like ping and pl. Shown only when you are connected to a server.

quad.desc: Part of your inventory - quad damage.

radar.desc: Plots the players on a picture of the map. (Only when watching MVD's or QTV).

score_bar.desc: Team, enemy, and difference scores together.

score_enemy.desc: Scores of enemy or enemy team.

scoreclock.desc: Shows current date and time on the scoreboard

scoremapname.desc: Shows map name on the scoreboard

speed.desc: Shows your current running speed. It is measured over XY or XYZ axis depending on 'xyz' property.

speed2.desc: Shows your current running speed. It is measured over XY or XYZ axis depending on 'xyz' property.

teamfrags.desc: Show list of team frags in short form.

teamholdbar.desc: Shows how much of the level (in percent) that is currently being held by either team.

teamholdinfo.desc: Shows which important items in the level that are being held by the teams.

teaminfo.desc: Show information about your team in short form.

teamstackbar.desc: Shows relative stacks of each team.

tracking.desc: Shows the name of tracked player.

vidlag.desc: Shows the delay between the time a frame is rendered and the time it's displayed.
